name: orchestra
description: Sol-led strategy routing with scoped context packets and pinned subagents

interface.longDescription: Keeps Sol / High as manager, selects a workflow strategy before choosing pinned Luna, Terra, or fresh Sol lanes, and limits delegated context to explicit evidence-backed packets.
defaultPrompt: Use $orchestra:orchestration to choose a strategy before tools, then execute and verify this task.
Keep context packets scoped; add workers or review only when their value exceeds orchestration overhead.
